narratives.name: Digital Sovereignty Play Context and Rationale
narratives.description: Why the Digital Sovereignty Play matters for addressing regulatory and data jurisdiction demands.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations worldwide face a convergence of regulatory mandates (GDPR, AI Act, NIS2), geopolitical supply chain risks, and growing recognition that hyperscaler dependencies compromise data jurisdiction and operational autonomy, creating urgent demand for sovereignty-aware technology strategies.

The Digital Sovereignty Play must equip sellers with structured tools -- a self-service Readiness Assessment, a collaborative Readiness Appraisal Workshop, and sovereignty-specific Customer Lens -- that transform abstract compliance concerns into actionable, measurable sovereignty programs connected to Red Hat's open hybrid cloud architecture.

Sellers apply the sovereignty Customer Lens to identify regulatory drivers, assess maturity through the seven-domain Readiness Assessment, facilitate cross-functional Readiness Appraisal Workshops that produce actionable roadmaps, and position Red Hat's code auditability, supply chain transparency, and workload portability as structural sovereignty advantages.

Organizations gain objective sovereignty baselines, prioritized transformation roadmaps, and clear pathways to sovereign infrastructure through Red Hat's open hybrid cloud platform, with ongoing monitoring that sustains compliance as regulatory landscapes evolve.

narratives.name: Digital Sovereignty Practice Intent
narratives.description: The end-to-end narrative of the Digital Sovereignty practice from regulatory discovery through sovereignty transformation.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations face escalating digital sovereignty demands driven by overlapping regulatory frameworks (GDPR, AI Act, NIS2), geopolitical supply chain risks, and growing awareness that hyperscaler dependencies can compromise data jurisdiction and operational autonomy.

The Sovereignty Readiness Assessment -- a 15-minute self-service tool evaluating maturity across seven domains -- provides an objective baseline that transforms abstract sovereignty concerns into measurable gaps. The Readiness Appraisal Workshop deepens this into a collaborative, cross-functional maturity evaluation with an actionable transformation roadmap.

Red Hat's open hybrid cloud architecture provides structural sovereignty advantages -- code auditability, transparent supply chains, no hidden dependencies, and workload portability across sovereign environments -- that proprietary platforms cannot match.

Sovereignty solution positioning connects regulatory requirements to Red Hat's architecture through on-premise deployment, sovereign cloud partnerships, in-region hosting, and data residency controls, addressing each customer's specific jurisdiction and compliance context.
Sovereignty deals advance through clear next steps including architecture reviews, pilot deployments in sovereign environments, and compliance validation against applicable regulatory frameworks.

Continuous sovereignty monitoring and evolving regulatory landscapes create ongoing advisory relationships that expand Red Hat's footprint as new sovereignty requirements emerge across additional workloads and geographies.

narratives.name: Sovereignty Readiness Assessment Value Story
narratives.description: Why structured sovereignty assessment across progressive depth levels drives better customer outcomes.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations struggle to objectively assess their sovereignty posture because sovereignty spans technical, regulatory, organizational, and supply chain dimensions that lack standardized measurement frameworks. Without a structured assessment, sovereignty investments are driven by anecdote and fear rather than evidence.

The Sovereignty Readiness Assessment provides four depth levels -- from a 15-minute self-service baseline through seller-guided discovery to comprehensive workshop appraisal and ongoing monitoring -- each producing increasingly actionable sovereignty insights matched to the customer's engagement depth.

A completed sovereignty assessment provides an objective maturity baseline, identifies priority gaps with remediation recommendations, and produces a transformation roadmap that connects sovereignty requirements to Red Hat's open hybrid cloud architecture.

narratives.name: Sovereignty Self-Assessment Guidance
narratives.description: How to facilitate the self-service Readiness Assessment effectively.

narrativeContexts.context: Customers often have vague sovereignty concerns driven by regulatory headlines but lack structured visibility into their actual sovereignty posture and specific gaps requiring attention.

The 15-minute self-service Readiness Assessment evaluates sovereignty posture across seven key domains, producing automated scoring and a maturity baseline. Each assessment question creates a natural discovery conversation opportunity. When gaps emerge, use findings to recommend the comprehensive Readiness Appraisal Workshop for deeper evaluation.
The completed self-assessment provides customers with an objective sovereignty snapshot and sellers with structured discovery data that frames the deeper sovereignty advisory conversation.

narrativeContexts.context: The sovereignty context assessment begins with mapping regulatory drivers (GDPR, AI Act, NIS2) to the customer's operating jurisdictions, followed by the 15-minute self-service Readiness Assessment that provides an objective baseline across seven sovereignty domains.

Assessment results are validated with the customer and interpreted in context of their specific industry, geography, and strategic priorities, identifying which sovereignty domains warrant deeper evaluation.

patternViews.name: Engagement & Assessment
patternViews.description: Engage stakeholders and conduct deep sovereignty appraisal.

narrativeContexts.context: Sovereignty stakeholders across functions (Business Leader, Procurement, CTO/Platform Engineering) are engaged with tailored discovery addressing their specific sovereignty perspective, building toward the comprehensive Readiness Appraisal Workshop.

The half-day Readiness Appraisal Workshop produces capability-level maturity evaluation, evidence-based scoring, and a collaboratively-developed transformation roadmap with prioritized remediation recommendations.

patternViews.name: Solution & Advancement
patternViews.description: Position sovereignty solutions and advance to transformation.

narrativeContexts.context: Red Hat's sovereignty approach is positioned against the customer's documented requirements, demonstrating open-source transparency, hybrid cloud sovereignty capabilities, and sovereign infrastructure options matched to their jurisdiction.

The sovereignty engagement advances to implementation with agreed architecture reviews, pilot deployments, compliance validation, and continuous monitoring that sustains compliance as regulatory landscapes evolve and new sovereignty requirements emerge.
